title: Add admin user and admin panel for managing bookings

requirements.summary: Add an admin panel page accessible via Internet Identity that displays all submitted bookings in a table for authorized admin users
acceptanceCriteria: An /admin route or admin section is accessible from the site (e.g., via a hidden nav link or direct URL).
The page shows a 'Login with Internet Identity' button when the user is not authenticated.
After successful Internet Identity login, the frontend calls isAdmin and shows the bookings table if true.
The bookings table displays all fields: ID, service type, category, name, phone, date, message, status.
Non-admin authenticated users see an 'Access Denied' message.
The admin panel matches the existing cosmic/mystical visual theme.

file_operations.description: Create the main admin page component that checks authentication status using useInternetIdentity hook. When not authenticated, display a login button. When authenticated, call the backend isCallerAdmin query using the actor from useActor hook. If admin, render the AdminDashboard component. If authenticated but not admin, display an 'Access Denied' message styled to match the cosmic theme with gold accents and dark background.

Create the admin dashboard component that fetches all bookings using getAllBookings backend query via useActor hook. Display bookings in a responsive table with columns: booking ID, service type, booking category, customer name, phone number, preferred date, message, and status. Apply the cosmic theme styling with dark background, gold borders, and hover effects. Include loading state while fetching data and error handling for failed queries. Use React Query for data fetching with proper cache invalidation.

Create a reusable bookings table component that accepts an array of Booking objects as props. Render a styled table matching the cosmic theme with columns for ID, service type, category, name, phone, preferred date, message, and status. Format service type and category enums to display human-readable labels. Handle empty states gracefully. Apply responsive design that collapses to cards on mobile devices. Use gold accent colors for headers and borders.

Create custom React Query hooks for admin functionality. Export useIsCallerAdmin hook that queries isCallerAdmin from the backend actor, enabled only when actor is available and user is authenticated. Export useGetAllBookings hook that queries getAllBookings from the backend actor, enabled only when user is confirmed admin. Include proper error handling for authorization errors and loading states. Both hooks should depend on the actor from useActor hook.

Replace the current single HomePage render with a router setup. Import BrowserRouter, Routes, and Route from react-router-dom. Add routes for '/' (HomePage) and '/admin' (AdminPage). Wrap the routes in BrowserRouter. This enables navigation to the admin panel while keeping the homepage as the default view.

Add a hidden admin link that navigates to /admin route. The link should be subtle (e.g., small icon or text in the corner) to avoid cluttering the public navigation. Use React Router's Link or navigate function. Position it discreetly in the header, styled to match the cosmic theme. The link should be visible to all users but the admin page itself will handle authorization.
